levels.name: Easy Goal
levels.desc: An open goal on a flat plane. Should be an easy start.
levels.hint: Try attaching a right powered wheel to the goal piece.

texts.text: Attach an R wheel (4) with a wooden rod (5) to the goal piece and press SPACE!

levels.name: Rocky Steps
levels.desc: Rougher terrain makes a tougher path. Are you ready for that trek?
levels.hint: More wheels, more power! Get that pink piece on the move.

levels.name: Going Up!
levels.desc: How to lift a goal piece?
levels.hint: Wheels can do this easily, or a seesaw? Try for Boomerang Badge this level?

levels.name: Rolling Hills
levels.desc: A bit of time to relax. Breathe in the fresh air. Take yourself wherever the wind takes you.
levels.hint: The hills are already slanted. You shouldn't need power to get your creation to move.

levels.name: Going Up and Away!
levels.desc: Even harder doing it over there!
levels.hint: Some sort of lifter that activates when you hit things?

levels.name: Uphill Battle
levels.desc: It's avalanche season, duck, cover, run! Try not to get caught up in the fall.
levels.hint: Some temporary shelter while it blows over would go a long way.

levels.name: Hold On
levels.desc: The brick seems to be alive? Well- maybe not alive, but it's definitely moving.
levels.hint: The brick seems to move to the goal, maybe we can grab onto it.

levels.name: Crooked Seesaw
levels.desc: A toy, once used for fun, now strewn through the clouds.
levels.hint: You can make rods heavier by selecting them and scrolling on the mouse wheel.

levels.name: Swiping the Idol
levels.desc: I sure hope that large boulder doesn't have anything do to with the level.
levels.hint: idk you can add one in later ig

levels.name: On Your Marks
levels.desc: A small friendly game of speed; but talk about an unfair start!
levels.hint: Larger wheels seem to have a bit more power behind them.

levels.name: Going Away and Under
levels.desc: Now we have to drop it under the ground?

levels.name: Postman
levels.desc: It fits...

levels.name: Triballic
levels.desc: Not 1, not 2... 3 balls need delivery.

levels.name: A Long Way to Go
levels.desc: There's quite a drop down there. You'll have to find a safe way across.
levels.hint: It seems like we might be in need of a catapult.

levels.name: Ultra Triballic
levels.desc: Bouncing In 3 times.

levels.name: Material Sorting Machine
levels.desc: The remnants of a factory long gone. It seems to be part of what was once a waste disposal system.
levels.hint: Only one thing you can build with can pass through that ground.

levels.name: Broken Elevator
levels.desc: A shell of an elevator, now just an empty shaft. Maybe it could still be useful.
levels.hint: The walls look like they're made of rubber... stuff should grip quite well!

levels.name: To The Moon and Back
levels.desc: Don't ask me how the pink piece got stuck there. Just know I can't have it stay there for long. Bring it back safely.
levels.hint: Idk you can fill this one out!

levels.name: Don't let the door hit you on the way out
levels.desc: Swinging door
levels.hint: swing the door really hard

levels.name: Ball
levels.desc: Ball
levels.hint: The ball has gravity

levels.name: Crushing Feeling
levels.desc: Big heavy object incoming
levels.hint: Don't get crushed

levels.name: Crushing Feeling pt.2
levels.desc: Not as heavy, still heavy though.
levels.hint: Don't get crushed pt.2

levels.name: Out of Orbit
levels.desc: The planet is spinning quickly
levels.hint: nuh uh

levels.name: Crushed
levels.desc: get crushed
levels.hint: get crushed by the crushing block

levels.name: Coming Soon More Levels
levels.desc: Not built yet — sorry. Coming soon.

texts.text: Perhaps you could design some levels.
